summary: Frontend-only testing of the redesigned bold 'House of the Knight' storefront (buckssauce-inspired). Exercised home hero (bottle+swatch active-product swapping, price/colour swap, discover link, add-to-bag, cart drawer), marquee/manifesto/collection sticky chapters (quick-add + view-product), armoury bundle builder (pick, slots, total, free-shipping, add-all), atelier/quotes/footer, newsletter success, header nav + theme toggle, product pages for all 4 slugs with qty controls + related cards, checkout fallback order placement (Razorpay-less reserve mode), login (admin) + /admin dashboard, and 390px mobile responsive sanity. All 4 /images/cut-*.png return 200 and are used by the hero.

ui_bugs.issue: Floating bottle cutouts overlap and partially hide the final word of the headline ('castle.' / 'the castl*') on the active-product state. The headline letters are visually cut by the Blonde Amber bottle at 1920x1080. Readability degraded.
data-testid 'intro-curtain' not found at any point on home load (checked immediately and after 2.5s). Spec in review request mentions it should appear then disappear.

issues: Bottles overlap body headline on desktop reducing readability of the last line.

action_items: Prevent hero bottle cluster from overlapping the headline on desktop (shift bottles further right, add z-index/clip, or constrain headline column width).
If the intro curtain is intended per spec, re-wire it so data-testid='intro-curtain' is rendered on first paint of /. If removed intentionally, update the spec/README.
critical_code_review_comments: Many /api/auth/me and /api/auth/refresh 401s on every page load for guests – noisy in console. Consider silently skipping /me on no-cookie first paint.
Lenis warning: 'container needs non-static position' is logged on home – add position:relative to the wrapper used by Lenis to avoid scroll offset miscalculations.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All critical frontend flows pass. Known minor issues: (1) hero bottles overlap headline on desktop; (2) intro-curtain testid never rendered. Newsletter success requires ~2s wait after submit (framer motion mount). Lenis smooth scroll is active – use window.__lenis.scrollTo(target,{immediate:true}). Payment is intentionally in reserve-only fallback (Razorpay keys absent) – 'Order reserved · payment pending' screen is the expected success state.
